body: JONAS ENDAIN, warlord of the Three-Spear tribe and first priest of the fire goddess Bhall, leader of the Clan of Embers in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: orc; male; hard middle age; massive and broad-shouldered. Grey-green battle-scarred skin, thick yellowed lower tusks, a shaved head with a black topknot, heavy brows over amber eyes.
costume: dented iron armour with rust-orange trim, a deerskin cloak charred at the edges, and a belt of tusk and bone trophies.
signature: The broad dark BURN SCAR across the left side of his face and neck, from the sacred fire of Braduk he walked into at his goddess's command, is always plainly visible.
extra: No skulls and no blood anywhere in the picture.

vibes.name: Voice in Fire
vibes.line: both hands cupped around his goddess's small undying flame at his chest, a girl's face faintly shaped in its white-gold fire; face drained grey, amber eyes cut sideways to it, wide, as if it just spoke; a black stone jungle shrine at midnight, the flame the only light.
vibes.wears: the vestments of Bhall's first priest: a long ember-red hide robe painted with black flame symbols, a collar of fire-blackened bone beads, bare iron bracers.

vibes.name: Five Thousand Spears
vibes.line: his right hand raising a heavy spear high over the host, his left hand gripping a round hide shield; chin up, tusks bared in a roar, eyes straight on the viewer; a jungle hilltop at night, five thousand spears raised below, bonfire light on his scarred side.
vibes.wears: a warlord's black-iron scale hauberk with spiked pauldrons, a shaggy black boar-hide mantle, and the Ember Banner's rust-orange hide sash across his chest.

vibes.name: Burned Prophet
vibes.line: his right hand swinging a smoking censer of embers, his left fist closed around fire-blackened bone prayer beads; head bowed, eyes lowered to the ash, jaw set; the ash fields outside Braduk the Burning at dusk, an ember-red sky, low gold light full on his burn scar.
vibes.wears: a penitent's rough ash-white hide wrap knotted at one shoulder, the other shoulder and arm bare and painted with black flame symbols.

vibes.name: Blasphemer Answered
vibes.line: head thrown back, shouting at the blizzard sky, his left fist shaking a spear at it, his right hand thrust up open to catch a column of white-gold fire pouring down into the palm; eyes wide on the sky; Braduk at night in a blizzard, snow lit gold.
vibes.wears: the Three-Spear tribe's tan deerskin cloak, frost in its fur, over battered grey iron mail, snow settling on his shoulders.
